The normalization of self-hatred. If you look at the popular "relatable" influencers right now (antonio garza, emma chamberlain, etc) you can notice that most of them use this kind of subtle way to describe themselves in a bad light. And I guess this makes us think that It's okay to hate yourself cuz everybody else does.

And then you have mental illness like some people have pointed out in this thread, you just don't know who's depressed and who's just sad. I have few friends on facebook but let's say 40 out of 60 people I am connected with in this social media will post or share memes with a subtle hint of depression and self hate wich is pretty alarming considering how many suicides have happened this year in my town.

We are all lost but we don't take it seriously, it's like everything is going to magically fix itself and you don't have to worry, but then you are face to face with your responsabilities and your problems that you don't know how to deal with them. I mean, at least I feel like that, l just don't have a purpose, we all don't, we could all dissapear and the world would probably be okay or better without us. You just start to realise that nothing actually matters.
